brief:
Israeli occupation forces prevented the UN Children's Fund (UNICEF) from delivering a water tank to besieged homes in the village of Qassra south of Nablus on Sunday, Shehab Wire reported. The blockade cuts off access to potable water for residents trapped in the area.

The village of Qassra has been under siege, leaving residents dependent on humanitarian aid deliveries to meet basic needs. The blocked shipment underscores restrictions on relief efforts reaching Palestinian communities in the occupied West Bank.
